description: What the windows are allowed to ask the Rust side for. Tauri's own core, the zoom the ctrl +/- polyfill calls into, writing one file to a path the writer picked in a save dialog, and the second window a note pinned to the desktop opens in — which is hidden and shown again rather than closed, because a compositor that mishandles the destroy of an always-on-top window leaves the mark of it on the desktop.
